product_metadata.title: LIVILAN Black Marble Bathroom Rug Mat, Black Gold Ink Soft Memory Foam Non Slip Bath Rug, Thick Shaggy Bathroom Floor Carpet, Absorbent Super Cozy Machine Washable, 16" X 24"
features: NON SLIP and ABSORBENT: The Bath Mat is backed with PVC dots to prevent skidding. Make sure floors are dry underneath the rug to prevent the mat from slipping. And the Bath Mat with thousands of microfibers makes the rug absorb water fast and keeps your bathroom floor clean and dry.

MACHINE WASHABLE: The Memory Foam Bath Mat is super easy to clean. AND, it dries quickly! Simply throw your bath mat into your washing machine and lightly tumble dry on low heat. Color will stay vibrant and it will come out looking as good as new!

VERSATILE PURPOSE USE: The fashionable Bath Mat can be used at tub-side, front of the sink, or at any place in your home where you want support and warmth on your toes! TIP: The mat may come with creases when opening, it will be flat after iron or machine wash.

UNIQUE DESIGN: The stylish bath mat in Black Marble Ink pattern is suitable for master bathroom, vanity and guest suite. This creative and unique pattern makes you enjoy your bath time. Great gift ideal for Christmas, Wedding, Birthday, Valentines and so on.
QUALITY GUARANTEE: If you have any issue upon receiving the item, please contact us immediately. We will respond within 24 hours and make sure your issue is well taken care of.
